name: Donut Chart
hint: Click a segment: it sweeps round the whole ring and splits into its sub-categories. Hover to roll the centre.
description: A part-to-whole donut you can open up: your slices, your formats. Hovering, focusing or selecting a slice lifts it and rolls the centre from the total to that slice's amount and share. A slice with parts drills down: the arc sweeps round to take the whole ring, then splits into its parts in shades of its own colour, and the breadcrumb folds it back into its slot. Anything past `maxSlices` folds into a neutral Other that opens too. A ranked legend re-orders itself when values change, 2px surface gaps, softened corners, arrow-key navigation, a table view and a stacked layout (legend under the ring) under 540px. The sample content (`demo`) is a personal-finance app's monthly spending with a month switcher.
intents: donut chart with drill down into subcategories
part to whole chart with legend and total
usage: Use for a part-to-whole split of one total into at most seven named parts (the rest folds into Other). Pass `data` as [{ id, label, value, children? }] (or name your own fields with `idKey`, `labelKey`, `valueKey`, `childrenKey`) and format amounts with `formatValue`. Own the selected slice with `selected` + `onSelectedChange(id)`; `onSegmentClick(datum)` fires on every slice or legend-row click and on Enter. Put your own text in the hole with `centerLabel` (a node, or ({ total, item, selected }) => node). Own the data states with `loading`, `error` + `onRetry` and `emptyMessage`. Values below zero count as zero. When readers need to compare parts precisely or across periods, use Bar Chart. The sample's month switcher is the kit's shared `Segmented` control from components/_shared/chart.jsx, which has no slug of its own.

Field holding a slice's parts.
Largest slices kept (1–7); the rest fold into Other. Same as maxCategories, which it overrides.

How the ring and the legend are arranged: "side" puts the legend beside the ring, "stacked" puts it under the ring in a narrower card (440px) and shrinks the ring to fit. Below 540px of width the chart stacks on its own whatever this says.
